scientific_limitations: Exactly two time samples and all but two Fourier coefficients, using the unitary discrete Fourier transform, for dimension n at least four.
Complex, equally weighted linear samples; no nonuniform weights or sparsity assumptions.
The dimension-dependent frame bounds are proof-based; finite checks only corroborate selected cases.
Equivalent results may exist under two-projection, partial Fourier, or filter-bank terminology.
title: Sharp mixed time–Fourier sampling with two spatial observations
